sn35.1:1.1: The “interior” (_ajjhatta_) of the title indicates the “interior” aspect of the sense fields, namely the sensory organs, as opposed to the sense stimuli, which are “exterior” (_bāhira_). Whereas the more common pair _ajjhatta_ and _bahiddha_ (internal/external) refer to what is inside one’s body as opposed to what is outside, _ajjhattika_ and _bāhira_ refer to the subjective aspect of the senses and what is perceived. Thus they are not fully identical. For example, the eye of someone else people is “interior” (_ajjhattika_) but “external” (_bahiddha_). On the other hand, the sound of one’s own voice is “internal” (_ajjhatta_) but “exterior” (_bāhira_).
